block_size.description: Block size for read/write operations; documented in dc3dd(1) as `bs`

hash.description: List of hash algorithms to compute (e.g., ['md5','sha256']); valid values per dc3dd(1) include md5, sha1, sha256, sha512

hashlog.description: File path to write hash computation log

errors.description: Error handling mode: exit (default), skip, or stop

disk.description: Enable disk duplication mode; per dc3dd(1) adds sector counting and geometry awareness

log.description: Log file for detailed disk duplication operations

seek.description: Number of blocks to skip in output before writing (dc3dd(1) `seek`)

skip.description: Number of blocks to skip in input before reading (dc3dd(1) `skip`)

diff.description: File to write differences found during verification

output_format.description: Output format: raw (default), host, or compressed (per dc3dd(1) `outputformat`)

logfile.description: File to write standard diagnostic/log messages
